title: lists layout runs only: not a redraw, an export or a feed being added
why: Every running job reported as a layout: a quit during a redraw is asked about as a layout, and an export is counted twice.

title: lists none that has ended, however it ended
why: A layout that has ended still reported: every later quit is asked about a layout that is not running.

title: does not report again while the list stays the same, whatever else a job says
why: The report sent at every change of any job: a run's progress sends main the same list many times a second.

title: says at once that it runs none, so a page just loaded is heard
why: Nothing reported until a job changes: a page loaded again after a crash leaves main with no report from it.

title: sends a report main did not take again at the next change
why: A report main refused counted as sent: main is left without it until the list changes.

title: stops hearing the jobs when it is stopped
why: The subscription never released: a dialog mounted again reports twice at every change.

title: stops every export and layout still running, and nothing else
why: Close anyway leaves the layouts running: on macOS the engine goes on with a layout whose window is closed.

title: stops every export and layout still running, and nothing else
why: Close anyway stops every job, a feed being added among them, which the question never said it would.
